So for each position i, it selects positions 0..i (inclusive), so the width at position i is i+1.

```python

length = rasp.SelectorWidth(all_selector)
```

This will return `[N, N, ..., N]` for a sequence of length N.

So, for each position i, we want to select the token at index N-1-i.

- For i=0: N-1-0 = N-1 (last element)

- ...

So, to select for each position i the token at index `N-1-i`, we can do:

- For each i, set key = i
- For each j, set query = N-1-j
- Select where key == query

- keys = rasp.indices (i)
- queries = length - 1 - rasp.indices (N-1-j)

So, for each i, select all j such that i == N-1-j, i.e., j == N-1-i.

So, for each i, select the token at index j = N-1-i.
